title: Units that trip people up

milestone.title: Binary: The Language of the Machine

description:
Write:

```python
def as_gib(size_in_bytes)                      # gibibytes (1,024³ bytes), rounded to 1 decimal place
def download_seconds(megabytes, megabits)      # seconds to download that many MB at that many megabits per second
```

- `as_gib(1_000_000_000_000)` is the "1 TB" drive from the lesson: **931.3**.
- `download_seconds(5000, 100)`: 5,000 MB is 40,000 megabits, at 100 per second that is **400.0** seconds. (Here MB means a million bytes and a megabit a million bits, so only the factor of 8 matters.)

`round(x, 1)` rounds to one decimal place.
hints: A gibibyte is `1024 ** 3` bytes: divide, then `round(..., 1)`.
Turn megabytes into megabits by multiplying by 8, then divide by the speed in megabits per second.
